words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with one QA vendor invited, no bids, and its bidding window (with the extra closing time) already over.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The invited QA vendor prices the line on the bid.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Order not active”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).
